translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Tingoaron Kkeman
Aaemweoi Pharisees me Sadducees ra itto reen Jesus pwe repwe aegina, iwe ra tingoareei pwe epwe feeori eew kkeman, pwe epwe pwae noa pwe Deus e tipieew ngaeni.
Nge Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Iga aenet epwe tupwutiw oawwa aepesa, ‘Epwe igin gacch raaen naiu, pwe a ccha noa noan naaeng.’

Nge nee oatosor moawugowug oawwa aepesa pwe, ‘Epwe igin piung worhow raaeneei, pwe a ccha me roorh noa noan mann.’ Oawwa mmwenen aepesa wunuunun raaen mwaai me raaen aenneew reen aaemi weri noan mann, nge oawsoapw mmwenen aweweei minikka aeginnen mweoi kkeei!

A ifa mwo aenneewan me aar se niugiuniug aeremesaen mweoi e igina! Oawwa tingoar ngaeniaei pwe ipwe feeori eew kkeman. Nge esoapw yor eew kkeman epwe pwae ngaenigaemi me niugiunoan kkeman we kkemenaen profeta Jonah.” Iwe nge Jesus a nigitiir a noa taaw noa.
Aar Yeast Pharisees me Sadducees
Igiwe rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra noa epeig meoneoiniun we, ra maniuwegi noa pwe repwe pweipwog fenoawa.
Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Oaw atapeonneogiugaemi nge aefaennigaemi reen yeast we aar Pharisees me Sadducees.”
Iwe rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra rhaepetae reen kkepas fengaen nee fineer, “A aepesa kkepas eei pwe iga sise pweipwog fenoawa.”
Jesus a giuneei meeta we ra aepesa, iwe a aeiineeor pwe, “Meeta oawwa fioangei nee finaemi aan esooar fenoawa reemi reen? Me gaen mwittiginen aaemi niugiuniug!
Meeta, oawsaaen metaf mwo? Oawse maengiy igiwe i giniiy niffai fenoawa wooar rhooawe nimingeras? Fitowu rhiug oawwa oawuta reen minikkewe nusegin mwongo?
Nge oatowe i giniiy fenoawa kkewe fiusiufai wooar rhooawe faangeras, fitowu rhiug oaw oawuta reen minikkewe nusegin mwongo?
Ifa wusun imwu oawse metaf pwe ise kkepesaen fenoawa ngaenigaemi? Oawpwe aefaennigaemi reen aar yeast Pharisees me Sadducees!”
Iwe rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra metefaaegini pwe Jesus ese kkepesaen pwe repwe aefaenniir reen yeast we eno noan fenoawa, pwe saengi aar Pharisees me Sadducees fenai.
Peter e Iura pwe Jesus Ina Kristus
Jesus a noa ngaeni pwiuneoi we e arap ngaeni aepinoamwon Caesarea Philippi, igiwe a aeiineeor rhooan kkayeo kkewe me ee pwe, “Iyo ee aeremas ra aepesa pwe iiy Naiun Aeremas?”
Ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Aaemweoi re iura pwe John Baptist, nge aaemweoi re iura pwe Elijah, nge aaemweoi re iura pwe Jeremiah aere aaemweoi profeta.”
Jesus a aeiineeor pwe, “Nge aaemi, oaw iura pwe ngaang iyo?”
Simon Peter a paniuwaeni pwe, “Een Kristus iwe Naiun Deus iwe e menaw.”
Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Wenepwu ngaeniug, Simon naiun John! Pwe kkepas eei ese itto reemw me reer aeremas, pwe Semaei noan naaeng minne e pwaeri ngaeniug.
Iwe ipwe aengaeniug pwe een Peter: een efai faai.
Nge wooan wungaen fai een ipwe aiuwtae aaei keneisia wooan, nge maenoa mwo nge esoapw tongaeni oatoaropa.
Ngaang ipwe ngaenneog kkiaen Mweoiun Naaeng; minne oawwa feoti me feoniufan epwe pwan feofeo me wooan naaeng, nge minne oawwa saeneti me wooan feoniufan epwe pwan saenetaeg me wooan naaeng.”
Iwe Jesus a aetiwenig ngaeniir rhooan kkayeo kkewe pwe resoapw aengaeni mwo nge erhai pwe iiy miniwe Kristus.
Jesus a Aepesa Waeiraesin me Maenoan

Saengi rhag oatowe nge Jesus a rhaepetae aan aemmetefa ngaeniir rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun pwe, “Ipwene noa Jerusalem, nge ipwene noa waeiraes me reer mwaaen kkewe aar, me soamwoonin patere kkewe me rhooawe sinsein anniug. Repwe niaei noa, nge mwirin enuuw raaen nge ipwe menaw sefaaen.”
Iwe Peter a wummwuw noa egius nge a noa soong ngaeni pwe, “Soamwoon, esoapw ina minna! Esoapw mmwenen wen ngaeniug minna!”
Nge Jesus a toagun ngaeni Peter nge a aengaeni pwe, “Rhiuw me oaroi, Saetan, een rhooan pineyiaei. Pwe oamw niunniuwaen ese itto me reen Deus, pwe e itto me reen aeremas.”
Iwe Jesus a aengaeniir rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun pwe, “Aere erhai a mwerhaen tapweaei, epwe aerheei noa niunniuwaennen wooan oanongan, a aiufera aan kurus nge tapweeito mwiriy.
Pwe iyo e mwerhaen ammwarhiu menewan, epwe ppiung saengi; nge iyo eppiung saengi menewan pwonno ngaang, epwe giuneei menaw.
Epwe meeta ipitan aaen yo faeinaengiy nniuw noa ngaeni erhai, nge ese yo ngaeni menewan? Esooar ngaere! Esoapw yor meeta erhai epwe tongaeni fangenoa pwe epwe pwigi sefaaeniy menewan.
Pwe Naiun Aeremas epwe war noan nningen minna Seman me angkenus kkewe naiun. Enoa oatonaan nge a aesefaaeni ngaeni erhai me erhai aeremas wunuunun aan feoffeeor.
Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe eyor aaemweoi aeremas igeei resoapw mae, toori oatona repwe weri Naiun Aeremas epwe wareto pwe King.”

footnotes.text: Wewen Peterme noan kkepesaen Greek nge faai.
